document_title: Process Transfer Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Transfer plan spans the whole process train; entities are the two sites, the Step 3-10 process steps, the instrumented scale-down systems, the validated analytical methods and the attributes the control strategy governs.
The distinctive objects are the TransferGap entries (transfer_has_gap assertions); each gap is anchored twice, on the §8 narrative sentence that argues it and on its row of the gap register.

Gap status follows the register the document renders: four gaps are open and two (GAP-02, GAP-04) are in progress because their mitigations have already started. None is closed, which is a weaker claim than all being open.

Strictly prospective: the document reports no characterization outcome, so the annex carries no parameter classification, no capability and no design space. The counts asserted are the prospective ones — the study-type allocation, the attribute register and the qualification batch count.

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 defines the scope of the transfer of the A-Mab drug substance process, the activities it comprises and the deliverables that must be complete before process performance qualification can start at the receiving site.

source_references.quote: this plan defines the scope of that transfer, the activities it comprises, and the deliverables that must be complete before process performance qualification can start at the receiving site

statements.statement_text: PTP-001 is the parent of the A-Mab characterization campaign and states why each of its documents exists.

source_references.quote: This plan is the parent of that campaign and states why each of its documents exists

statements.statement_text: The scope of the plan is the drug substance process, Steps 3 to 10, as it will be operated at the receiving site.

source_references.quote: The scope of this plan is the drug substance process, Steps 3 to 10, as it will be operated at the receiving site

statements.statement_text: Technology transfer is an element of the pharmaceutical quality system and is expected to deliver the knowledge that lets the receiving site run the process as intended.

source_references.quote: Technology transfer is an element of the pharmaceutical quality system, and it is expected to deliver the knowledge that allows the receiving site to run the process as it was intended to run

statements.statement_text: Viral safety is modular: clearance comes from 3 steps whose mechanisms are independent of one another, and no single step carries the whole claim.

source_references.quote: Clearance comes from 3 steps whose mechanisms are independent of one another

statements.statement_text: The site equivalency comparison shows that the receiving site holds equipment of the same class in the same sequence, under the same quality system.

source_references.quote: The comparison shows that the receiving site holds equipment of the same class in the same sequence, under the same quality system

statements.statement_text: The comparison does not show that the equipment holds every parameter to the range the process needs; that is established parameter by parameter in the characterization reports.

source_references.quote: It does not show that the equipment holds every parameter to the range the process needs

statements.statement_text: A scale-down model may support a range claim only where it has been qualified against data at scale for the step it represents.

source_references.quote: A scale-down model may support a range claim only where it has been qualified against data at scale for the step it represents (SOP-1001)

statements.statement_text: The characterization scope assigns 22 of the 37 process parameters to multivariate designs and 15 to one-factor-at-a-time assessment, on the basis set out in RA-001.

source_references.quote: Of the 37 parameters in the process, 22 are studied in multivariate designs and 15 are assessed one factor at a time

statements.statement_text: Viral clearance is not measured on commercial batches: it is claimed from spiking studies on qualified small-scale models, and the commercial process is never spiked.

source_references.quote: Clearance is claimed from spiking studies executed on qualified small-scale models, and the commercial process is never spiked

statements.statement_text: The drug substance attribute register holds 10 attributes, of which 6 are of high or very high criticality and 3 are of very high criticality.

source_references.quote: The register holds 10 attributes, of which 6 are of high or very high criticality, and the 3 of very high criticality are high mannose and the two viral clearance claims

statements.statement_text: The plan is prospective with respect to the control strategy: it defines no design space and classifies no parameter, because both are outputs of the characterization package.

source_references.quote: This plan defines no design space and classifies no parameter, since both are outputs of the characterization package and neither is created by the act of transfer

statements.statement_text: Until PCMR-001 is approved the classifications carried in the batch record are provisional, and the receiving site operates to the platform set-points and normal operating ranges in the interim.

source_references.quote: Until PCMR-001 is approved, the classifications carried in the batch record are provisional

statements.statement_text: Process performance qualification is Stage 2 of the lifecycle and follows this transfer.

source_references.quote: Process performance qualification is Stage 2 of the lifecycle and it follows this transfer

statements.statement_text: Qualification is 5 consecutive commercial-scale drug substance batches run at the set-points with every parameter inside its normal operating range.

source_references.quote: The receiving site manufactures 5 consecutive drug substance batches at commercial scale, at the set-points, with every parameter held inside its normal operating range

statements.statement_text: Six gaps were identified during transfer planning and none of them is closed at the date of the plan.

source_references.quote: Six gaps were identified during transfer planning, and none of them is closed at the date of this plan

statements.statement_text: Two of the six gaps are recorded as in progress rather than open, because their mitigations have already started.

source_references.quote: because their mitigations have already started, with reserve reagent lots held at the sending site (GAP-02) and the performance matching recorded as each scale-down model is qualified (GAP-04)

statements.statement_text: GAP-02, GAP-04 and GAP-06 must close before qualification and are prerequisites for it; GAP-03 is carried into Stage 3 and is not closed by qualification at all.

source_references.quote: GAP-02, GAP-04 and GAP-06 close before qualification and are prerequisites for it.
